data.narrative:
DEFCON AI, a Seed-stage defense and security AI company founded by Yisroel Brumer, Paul Selva, and Grant Verstandig, has raised $44M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at Seed or Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $44M raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage funding, yields $110M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Stark Defence at $4.0B, Castelion at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $94M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $555M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around comparable company relevance—peer valuations span nearly a full order of magnitude—and reflects the nascent, heterogeneous nature of the defense AI sector. Stage progression yields a more conservative estimate; peer multiples suggest higher valuations are supportable, contingent on product-market fit and customer traction visibility.
